captures.title: Facilitator: name the shared training workspace

focus.text: Use jdi-training-manual for this rehearsal.
Open Advanced, then choose the approved Fabric capacity.

captures.title: Facilitator: use the existing F64 capacity

focus.text: Select rayfintestenv - West US 2, not a trial or another capacity.
Apply creates the workspace with this assignment.

captures.title: Create your learner folder

focus.text: Replace demo with your learner or pair suffix.
Create the folder, then open it.

captures.title: Import the student notebooks

focus.text: Select Import, then Notebook.
Choose From this computer.

captures.title: Open the notebook upload

focus.text: Choose Upload to select your STUDENT notebook files.

captures.title: Check the import completed

focus.text: Look for Imported successfully. Do not upload again if it already succeeded.

captures.title: Verify the six student notebooks before creating the lakehouse

focus.text: Start with Lab 00. Work through the numbered notebooks in order.
Lab 05 must also be present. Keep solution files in a separate folder.

captures.title: Create your own schema-enabled lakehouse

focus.text: Name it lh_woodlands_<your suffix>. The rehearsal uses demo.
Leave Lakehouse schemas checked.
Select Create and wait for the lakehouse to open.

captures.title: Check the new lakehouse is empty

focus.text: Tables contains the default dbo schema. The notebooks will populate it.
Files will hold imagery caches and the GeoJSON map export.

captures.title: Facilitator: keep the workshop on Runtime 1.3

focus.text: Check 1.3 (Spark 3.5, Delta 3.2). Do not substitute a different major runtime.

captures.title: Facilitator: check Full mode and save the 14-library definition

focus.text: Use YML editor view to paste the supplied Environment definition.
Use Full mode. Scroll the library list to inspect all 14 entries.
Save and confirm. Then Home > Publish > Publish all > Publish.

captures.title: Facilitator: wait for successful publication

focus.text: All 14 library rows must report Success. Saving alone is not publication.
Runtime stays at 1.3. The notebooks can now attach this Environment.

captures.title: Choose the Environment from the correct workspace

focus.text: Select env_forestops.
Verify Location is jdi-training-manual, not one of the reference workspaces.
Confirm, then repeat the attachment for every notebook.

captures.title: Attach the Lakehouse item, not the SQL endpoint

focus.text: Choose the Lakehouse icon in the first row. The second row is the SQL endpoint.
Check your lakehouse name and its workspace before adding it.
Select Add. Never attach another learner's lakehouse.

captures.title: Check the three notebook attachments

focus.text: Language: PySpark (Python).
Environment: env_forestops from this workspace.
Your lakehouse has the default pin. Repeat for all six notebooks.

captures.title: Explicitly set your default lakehouse

focus.text: Open the lakehouse's More options menu and choose Set as default lakehouse.
Wait for saving, reopen the notebook, and confirm your lakehouse is still attached.

captures.title: Complete the exercise, then run and validate that cell

focus.text: Replace the numbered TODOs with your code; keep validation cells intact.
Select Run cell. Wait for completion and check for PASS before continuing.

captures.title: Lab 00: check the printed configuration

focus.text: Use EPSG:2953 for analysis and synthetic_stands: true for the workshop.
The workspace and lakehouse labels must match your own setup.

captures.title: Lab 00 checkpoint: all stand centroids are inside the area

focus.text: Confirm 120/120 inside, with PASS. A completed cell can still print FAIL.
The bronze_stand_register table now contains the display centroids.

captures.title: Automatic STAC reference: six catalogue scenes

focus.text: The automatic route found six scenes here. The supplied manual route uses one.
Persist unsigned source URLs, never temporary SAS tokens.
The stored native projection is EPSG:32619. Keep it for reprojection.

captures.title: Lab 02 checkpoint: the Silver quality gate must be open

focus.text: This rehearsal has 119 trusted stands out of 120. Coverage can vary by imagery.
Continue only with Gate open and every validation marked PASS.

captures.title: Lab 03 checkpoint: classifications and review flags

focus.text: Compare only the retained stands: 119 in this rehearsal.
The review queue has 13 stands. The demonstration uses a simulated prior period.

captures.title: Lab 04 checkpoint: recognize offline demonstration narratives

focus.text: The rehearsal wrote 40 narratives, not one narrative for every stand.
offline-stub is deliberate. These are not live model responses.
Check zero failed rows and keep the validation guard enabled.

captures.title: Lab 05 checkpoint: verify the four Gold tables

focus.text: 119 retained facts differ from the full 120-stand register. Keep both counts.
The date and class dimensions are also written to your learner lakehouse.

captures.title: Lab 05: check the GeoJSON export readback

focus.text: Use Files/gold/maps/stand_classification.geojson as the native Map layer.
Check 120 registered features, 119 retained results and one missing result.
Readback must report PASS before you build the Map.

captures.title: Independently check the period and register coverage

focus.text: Run the read-only coverage query after the Gold tables synchronize.
For 2026-08-31: 120 registered, 119 retained, one missing and 99.17%. Keep this SQL ground truth.

captures.title: Create a native Fabric Map

focus.text: Use map_woodlands_<your suffix> in your learner folder.
Create the Map item. This is not a Power BI map visual.

captures.title: Connect the Map to your own lakehouse

focus.text: Select lh_woodlands_demo, or your own suffixed Lakehouse.
Confirm Location is jdi-training-manual.
Select Add to connect the source.

captures.title: Display the exported stand polygons

focus.text: Select the maps folder, not only its expansion arrow, to open the file pane.
Open the GeoJSON file's More options menu and select Show on map.

captures.title: Style the actual categories, including missing results

focus.text: Enable data-driven styling and Color by map_class, using Category.
Use gray #61717D for no_classified_result. It is not a healthy or unclassified stand.
Keep extrusion off and use 65% fill opacity for readable polygons.

captures.title: Inspect the period, quality and synthetic provenance

focus.text: Hover a polygon and check its stand ID, reporting date, class and hectares.
Scroll inside the tooltip to inspect stand_source: synthetic. Collapse the legend if it overlaps.

captures.title: Inspect stands with no retained classification

focus.text: Filter coverage_status to no_classified_result. This rehearsal has one such stand.
Remove filters before saving the complete map.

captures.title: Set the view learners will see when the Map opens

focus.text: After Zoom to fit, open Map settings.
Choose Set initial view, close the pane, then Save and wait for confirmation.

captures.title: Reopen the saved Map and check all four categories

focus.text: The saved item opens in Viewing mode over the New Brunswick stands.
The gray missing-result polygon remains visible beside retained classifications.

captures.title: Create your native Fabric Data Agent

focus.text: Name it agent_woodlands_<your suffix> in your learner folder.
Create the item. No Azure OpenAI key is needed for this exercise.

captures.title: Add the learner lakehouse as the agent's data source

focus.text: Select your own lakehouse. Verify its workspace in the row details.
Select Add and wait for the source schema to load.

captures.title: Select only these four Gold tables

focus.text: gold_dim_date: reporting dates.
gold_dim_forest_class: class labels and definitions.
gold_dim_stand: the full stand register and coverage denominator.
gold_stand_facts: retained stand-period results. Leave the other tables unchecked.

captures.title: Save instructions that define grain, coverage and limitations

focus.text: Paste the complete instructions, replacing the starter text. Click the preview to save.
Coverage uses every registered stand, not only the retained facts.
Keep the simulated-baseline and offline-narrative limitations explicit.

captures.title: Add and validate the question/SQL pairs

focus.text: Enter the question, then let the portal finish saving before editing its SQL.
Replace the SQL placeholder. Click outside and wait for automatic validation.
Add all three examples. Reopen them and check that the saved queries match the handout.

captures.title: Check the full-register count against SQL

focus.text: The full register has 120 stands, including stands without a retained fact.
Expand completed steps to inspect the actual source, generated SQL and output.

captures.title: Require a date and whole-register coverage

focus.text: The reporting period must be an actual date: 2026-08-31 in this rehearsal.
119 out of 120 is 99.17%, not 100% of retained facts.
Inspect the generated SQL and compare it with your independent endpoint query.

captures.title: Verify the review queue and its limitations

focus.text: Expand response, then open Steps completed to inspect SQL and source output.
All 13 stand IDs and hectare values match the independently executed SQL.
Keep the simulated-data limitation. These flags are not operational forestry advice.

captures.title: Publish to Fabric without enabling an additional channel

focus.text: Describe the agent's read-only training purpose and limitations.
Leave Also publish to Microsoft 365 Copilot off for this workshop.
Publish only after all answer checks agree with SQL.

captures.title: Retest the published version after reopening

focus.text: Switch from Draft to Published. The label confirms which version you are testing.
The published answer still states the correct reporting date.
Recheck 120 registered, 119 retained, one missing and 99.17% coverage against SQL.

captures.title: Hand in links to your completed Fabric items

focus.text: Submit the published Data Agent and its independently checked answers.
Submit the saved Map, lakehouse and six completed notebook links. Stop your Spark session.
